_comment:
'**Legendary**\n\nWhen you pitch Heart of Fyendal, if you have less {h} than an opposing hero, gain 1{h}.' Generic Resource - Gem (promo printing; the slug carries the blue suffix though the name does not - file per setIdentifiers at adoption).

LEGENDARY NOT AUTHORED: printed keyword, deck-construction/DB-carried; the triage note concurs ('Legendary fires from the card DB keywords field').

TRIGGER: ON_PITCH is dispatched to the PITCHED CARD ITSELF - engine._dsl_pitch_listener (engine.py:1604-1609) takes event.data['card'] and dispatches ON_PITCH keyed on that card's slug - so this fires exactly when Heart of Fyendal is pitched, not when other cards are. Shipped precedents: blood_of_the_dracai_red, riches_of_tropal_dhani_yellow, arknight_shard_blue.

CONDITION TIMING: ability-level conditions are checked at triggered-layer resolution (interpreter._run_ability), which matches the printed 'when you pitch ..., if you have less {h} ...' - one check, at that moment. HEALTH_LT_OPP (condition_types.py:775-780) tests controller.life < opponent.life; 'an opposing hero' is multiplayer phrasing and this is its 2-player reduction, correct in every game this engine can run (same disclosure as fight_from_behind / comeback_kid).

EFFECT: GAIN asset LIFE_POINTS amount 1 routes effect_gain_life (effect_types.py:4890-4896) - CR 1.13.1 asset spelling, not GAIN_LIFE.
